b.label: UAP Gerb - The MITRE Corporation investigation

edges.label: Gerb authored and published the MITRE investigation
edges.note: Published 7 August 2026; the named priority document for this board. Two hours, seven chapters, building explicitly on eight prior Gerb investigations.

b.label: Independent media as the disclosure substrate

edges.label: The structural discipline is a product of the independent-media substrate
edges.note: The office-symbol-level structural work exists because a format existed that could carry two- and three-hour document-dense expositions. No broadcast or print outlet would have published it; the format created the discipline.

edges.label: MITRE is the exemplar instance of the mechanism
edges.note: MITRE operates six FFRDCs and describes itself as providing long-term strategic partnership and stability to government sponsors - the documented properties on which the concealment thesis rests.

edges.label: MITRE was created on the RAND model as the Air Force's systems engineering counterpart
edges.note: RAND, incorporated 1948 out of Project RAND, established the permanent contractor-operated analytical partner form; the Air Force replicated it for systems engineering in 1958.

a.label: UAP Gerb - The MITRE Corporation investigation

edges.label: Alleges MITRE support to two Navy-spearheaded legacy programs
edges.note: The two alleged programs: reverse engineering and maturation of technologies from late-1940s recoveries, and tracking of a large USO with semi-permanent Atlantic station, with all-source data processed by MITRE. Gerb notes the oddity that MITRE was founded by and modelled on USAF structures yet is intimately involved in Navy secret programs.

a.label: UAP Gerb - The MITRE Corporation investigation

edges.label: MITRE founded as the Air Force's successor to RAND
edges.note: The investigation restates the documented history that MITRE was established in 1958 as the Air Force's spiritual successor to RAND, tasked with systems engineering for SAGE.

a.label: UAP Gerb - The MITRE Corporation investigation

b.label: Rep. Burlison records demand to MITRE, 22 May 2026

edges.label: Published as declared support for the congressional inquiry opened 11 weeks earlier
edges.note: Burlison's letter is dated 22 May 2026; the investigation was published 7 August 2026 and states it seeks to directly aid that inquiry.

a.label: UAP Gerb - The MITRE Corporation investigation

edges.label: Groups Aerospace Corporation with MITRE as the FFRDC layer
edges.note: Gerb's FFRDC thesis treats MITRE and the Aerospace Corporation as parallel instances of the same mechanism; the Aerospace link is reinforced by Stephanie O'Sullivan's board membership there after ODNI. The specific allegation against Aerospace is inference from the model rather than a separately documented claim.

a.label: UAP Gerb - The MITRE Corporation investigation

edges.label: Establishes the FFRDC arbitration thesis
edges.note: Gerb's central structural claim: FFRDCs let the government vest programs outside the USG while retaining control of materials and data, and arbitrate what defense contractors are told about UFO programs.

a.label: UAP Gerb - The MITRE Corporation investigation

edges.label: Argues FFRDCs are the 'missing link' that lets programmes be vested outside government
edges.note: The structural argument is independently supported by FAR 35.017's dual-access provision, whatever the status of the specific allegations.

a.label: UAP Gerb - The MITRE Corporation investigation

edges.label: Alleges MITRE has held a Navy legacy reverse-engineering role since 1958
edges.note: Allegations include exploitation of non-human technologies from late-1940s recoveries and all-source processing of data on a very large Atlantic USO; no primary document has been produced.

a.label: UAP Gerb - The MITRE Corporation investigation

edges.label: Names MITRE as the central FFRDC node of the legacy portfolio
edges.note: The investigation alleges MITRE's founding in 1958 carried a hidden second impetus beyond SAGE systems engineering: constructing a trusted long-term partner answerable only to its DoD customer to spearhead reverse engineering of recovered craft.

a.label: UAP Gerb - The MITRE Corporation investigation

edges.label: Alleged 2011 restriction on historical briefings about program incumbents
edges.note: A policy act alleged to prevent even cleared personnel from being briefed on the programme's own history - concealment directed inward at the programme's own workforce rather than outward at the public.
